# Locust Kubernetes Operator

> Kubernetes operator for Locust. Run distributed Locust load tests on Kubernetes as a LocustTest custom resource, installed with Helm and built for CI pipelines.

The Locust Kubernetes Operator runs distributed Locust load tests on Kubernetes. A test is a LocustTest custom resource (locust.io/v2); the operator creates the master and worker Jobs and the master Service, reports the phase (Pending, Running, Succeeded, Failed) and conditions, and cleans up. Installed with Helm.

## Getting started

- [Locust on Kubernetes guide](https://abdelrhmanhamouda.github.io/locust-k8s-operator/locust-on-kubernetes/index.md): How distributed Locust works on Kubernetes, deployment options, a full walkthrough, CI usage and scaling
- [Quick Start](https://abdelrhmanhamouda.github.io/locust-k8s-operator/getting_started/index.md): Five-minute quick start
- [Install the Operator](https://abdelrhmanhamouda.github.io/locust-k8s-operator/helm_deploy/index.md): Helm chart installation and values
